name: Battisti
beschreibung: Haus Battisti enjoys a prime central location in St. Anton am Arlberg, just a short walk from the base station of the renowned Galzigbahn cable car. The holiday apartment features clean, comfortable furnishings with a separate living room, bedroom, and a well-equipped kitchenette. Guests can easily reach world-class ski slopes and the vibrant village centre on foot. Convenient on-site parking is also provided.
